newsitem.title: USA: Atrion to cut Sept 1 qtly div to $0.10.
newsitem.headline: Atrion to cut Sept 1 qtly div to $0.10.

text.p: Atrion Corp said on Wednesday it will cut its quarterly dividend from $0.20 per share to $0.10 per share, beginning with the dividend payable on September 1.
The current quarterly dividend, payable June 1 to shareholders of record as of May 20, will remain at $0.20 per share.

Atrion, which also said on Wednesday that it agreed to sell its natural gas pipeline, is shifting its focus to the medical-products business. Atrion said reducing the dividend would bring it more into line with dividends typically paid by medical-products companies, and also would provide more revenue to invest in ongoing businesses.
The dividend will be cut even if the pipeline sale is not concluded, Atrion said.
